summary: Iteration 3 verified two new features (BULK APPROVE + Pending-only shortcut). Backend: 48/48 pytest tests pass (7 new bulk-approval cases + 41 regression cases). Frontend E2E via Playwright covered all requested flows: logged-out state hides checkbox column and bulk-action-bar; login as 158 reveals select-all + per-row checkboxes; Pending-only toggles Approval filter to Not Approved with amber active state and clears on second tap; select-all shows 'N selected' bar, Approve selected updates all 3 rows to Approved (bar disappears, pending-only view becomes empty), Clear deselects and hides bar; selection resets when filters change; logout hides checkbox column. All test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: bulk_approval endpoint is routed BEFORE the parametrized {purchase_id}/approval route by using the distinct path /purchases/approval/bulk — safe against path collisions.

bulk_approval uses update_many with $in — efficient. modified_count is returned as 'updated'; note that already-approved rows won't be counted as modified even if included. Acceptable, but if UI expects exactly len(ids) it could show N-mismatch after re-clicking. Current UI just reports whatever backend returns, which is fine.

FilterBar.togglePending directly sets filters.approved to boolean false — buildParams correctly forwards it as 'false' (via URLSearchParams stringification of the boolean) and backend Optional[bool] parses it correctly.
selectedIds is cleared inside refresh() which fires after any filter/page change — good, avoids stale cross-page selections.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (carry-over from iteration 2), migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three backend test files under /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (CRUD/filters/exports), test_auth_bill.py (auth/approval/bill/Safety Shoes), test_bulk_approval.py (bulk endpoint + single approval regression). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. New testids exercised: pending-only-btn, select-all-checkbox, select-row-{id}, bulk-action-bar, bulk-selected-count, bulk-approve-btn, bulk-clear-btn. Pending-only active state uses bg-amber-500 class (assert 'amber' substring in class). Bulk endpoint route is PATCH /api/purchases/approval/bulk (distinct from /api/purchases/{id}/approval), returns {updated: N}.
